why_sam_was_not_run.summary: The 8 metered SAM requests were NOT spent. The previous live run spent 8 of the same key's 10/day budget EARLIER THE SAME UTC DAY (commit 060ea45 committed 2026-08-29 07:27:06 +0000; this session began 07:28 UTC). Running 8 more would have been requests 9-16 against a ~10/day key.
why_sam_was_not_run.why_the_ledger_said_otherwise: state/sam_request_ledger.json is gitignored and therefore regenerable; the fresh container reported '10 remaining' because the ledger lost its memory with the previous container, not because budget was available. CLAUDE.md says never bypass the ledger; running here would have relied on a ledger with amnesia.
why_sam_was_not_run.why_a_partial_run_is_worse_than_none: niche_scorer renormalizes weights PER NICHE when the SAM call fails. With ~2 requests left, 2 niches would score on set_aside+notice_flow+sb_win over 100 pts while 6 would score on set_aside+sb_win renormalized (x1.667). The table would print normally but composites would be silently incomparable across niches -- the same failure class the scorer's own design notes record three times.
why_sam_was_not_run.why_it_could_not_change_the_answer: set_aside_share is computed entirely from keyless USAspending award_count. The stated key question of this run (did the corrected set-aside code list raise the shares / reorder the ranking?) was answerable, and was answered, at zero SAM cost.
why_sam_was_not_run.budget_never_measured: SAM_DAILY_BUDGET is unset (defaults to 10). RUNBOOK step 1 instructs the founder to measure the real limit and set the env var; that has not been done, so the true ceiling is unknown.

set_aside_before_after.question: Commit 060ea45 added HS3, HS2Civ, RSBCiv, 8ACCiv, VSBCiv to SB_SET_ASIDE_CODES. Expectation stated for this run: shares should be HIGHER and possibly reordered.
set_aside_before_after.result: FALSIFIED -- not one award changed. Set-aside shares AND raw set-aside award counts are byte-identical before and after the fix, for all 8 niches.

per_code_probe_naics_541519.method: award_count(541519, 24mo, new_awards_only) with each code queried alone

negative_control.interpretation: USAspending returns HTTP 200 with count 0 for codes that do not exist, so a 0 is INDISTINGUISHABLE from an invalid code. The five added codes are indistinguishable from typos.

per_code_probe_naics_541519.sum_check: The 12 matching codes sum to 15,248 vs 15,249 for the combined union query -- the union is fully explained by codes that already worked before the fix. The five added codes contribute nothing.

set_aside_before_after.ordering_changed: YES, but NOT because of the set-aside fix. Ordering moved because commit 060ea45 also rewrote the scorer: price_band and repeat_bidders were deleted, sb_win_share was added, and weights changed from 35/30/20/15 to 40/40/20. In this run notice_flow is additionally absent, so weights renormalized to set_aside 66.7 / sb_win 33.3. The composites below are therefore NOT comparable to the previous run's composites.

findings.set_aside_exceeds_total_warning: NOT TRIGGERED for any niche -- the code list does not over-count. Its problem is the opposite: five of its entries are inert.
findings.all_gates_pass: All 8 niches pass both gates (buyer_size, activity) under the new gate definitions. The previous run's prospect-gate FAILs on 541519 and 561210 are gone because that gate was replaced, not because the underlying concern was resolved.
findings.notice_flow_absent: The 40-point notice_flow term is missing from every niche in this run. In the previous run it supplied ~69% of all realized spread. This ranking is therefore driven by set-aside share and SB win share only.

founder_action_needed: FOUNDER ACTION NEEDED: (1) The set-aside code-list fix in 060ea45 is INERT -- all five added codes (HS3, HS2Civ, RSBCiv, 8ACCiv, VSBCiv) match zero awards and are indistinguishable from invalid codes. Re-verify them against USAspending's setAsideTypeMapping before trusting any claim that the set-aside metric was corrected. (2) Measure the real SAM key limit and set SAM_DAILY_BUDGET (RUNBOOK step 1) -- the 10/day default is an unverified guess and the ledger does not survive container restarts, so it cannot protect an unattended run.
